source_provenance.reference: RLE: >=8 narrow candles, strong closed ignition candle, EMA9/SMA21 favorable, SMA200 not in way, signal-bar stop-entry opposite stop, 2R target
source_provenance.authenticity_note: Third-party transcript not independently verified against original premium video; quantified definitions below are Crypto Lab adaptations.

mechanical_signal.compression_reference_scope: 120 eight-candle envelope widths ending before the 8-candle candidate range; nearest-rank q25
mechanical_signal.force_candle_range_rule: strictly greater than max of the preceding 20 completed 1h high-low ranges
mechanical_signal.breakout_rule: closed ignition bar closes strictly beyond the maximum high/minimum low of preceding 8 completed 1h candles
mechanical_signal.direction: long on bullish ignition, short on bearish ignition
mechanical_signal.favorable_trend: long iff EMA9 > SMA21 AND close > SMA200; short iff EMA9 < SMA21 AND close < SMA200; indicators include closed ignition candle
mechanical_signal.main_group: RLE iff previous 8bar high-low envelope <= q25 of causal 120 historical 8bar envelope widths
mechanical_signal.control_group: Same ignition, trend, breakout, entry/exits/costs, but preceding 8bar envelope > causal q25 (non-narrow)

execution.entry: strictly following completed ignition 1h bar: stop entry at candle high + tick for long, low - tick for short
execution.stop: ignition candle low - tick for long, high + tick for short
execution.fill_gap: adverse entry gap to 1m open; adverse stop gap to 1m open; favorable target gap capped at target
execution.same_minute_collision: STOP_WINS_AFTER_ENTRY; pending signal + invalidation same minute assumes entry followed by stop
execution.pending_invalidation: if stop touched before entry, cancel
execution.time_exit: 1m OPEN at first minute >= entry time+1440m
execution.intergroup_runs: independent; only differential in compression gating

economic.cost_comment: 26/40 bps are route-agnostic research haircuts from prior MEXC lab practice; NOT independently certified fills for this experiment. Cannot claim executable micro-live without separate venue-specific orderbook receipts.

gates: RLE 95% week-block bootstrap lower bound net26 >0
RLE positive net26 mean in at least 2 of 3 years
RLE minus non-narrow control mean primary net26 >=5bps
paired ISO-week bootstrap 95% lower bound for RLE minus control mean primary net26 >0
largest ISO-week contribution <=25% of all positive RLE primary-net pnl

interpretation: Research novelty is compression-conditioned strong 8bar breakout vs equally strong noncompressed breakout, not a new profit claim; no claim of causal stops/forced-flow without flow evidence.
